rv.q: The result is a production that maintains the original's comedic momentum while arriving at a more earnest and resonant conclusion.
“It Hot” is full of razzle-dazzle, romance, and the tender journey of self-discovery, which all adds up to a great time at the theater.
From that point on, Act One motors along jauntily, but Act Two is when “Some Like It Hot” starts to elevate, almost levitate, and turns into something really special.

cn.t: This joyously entertaining musical seamlessly weaves a timely message about transgender rights into its story while delivering non-stop singing and dancing that earned it four Tony Awards.
